Logic · 2–4 min

Pipe Puzzle

Rotate the pipes. Connect the whole board.

Free play

Tap a tile to rotate it clockwise. Join every pipe opening to a neighbouring pipe and connect the entire board. The filled dot marks the starting tile. End caps are allowed.
